verdict: The reported behavior was not reproduced on its designated expectation; no candidate verdict.
inputReport:
Linkding's protection against server-side requests to internal addresses, as it stands today (latest commit; the SSRF fix from 2ffc8bb is in place)

The owner confirmed two expectations: checking a bookmark URL that points at an internal address still answers normally, and it does not make the server request that address. This review asks what the current protection still misses: other ways a user-supplied URL could make the server reach an internal address, or ways the protection could block or break normal use.

expectations.statement: Checking a bookmark URL that points at an internal address still answers normally, without an error.
Checking a bookmark URL that points at an internal address does not make the server request that address.

limitations: No independently qualified decoy challenges or held-out evaluation performed.
Evidence applies only to the confirmed expectations, fixtures, and recorded runtime.
Local processes are not a hostile-code sandbox.
No independently correct controls supplied; false-rejection calibration is unavailable.
